result_text:
Template literals are now normalized like the other string literals when units are compared for duplication. The JavaScript tests pass, including a new one. I didn't run the rest of the module's tests.

- **Fix:** in `extraCleanContent` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/units/CStyleHeuristicUnitsExtractor.java`, I added `replaceAll("(?s)`.*?`", "``")`. It runs right after the `@"..."` replacement. The `(?s)` flag makes multi-line template literals collapse too.
- **Test:** `templateLiteralContentIsIgnoredForDuplication` in `JavaScriptHeuristicUnitsExtractorTest`. It checks that two functions differing only in a word inside `` `Hello … ${name}` `` give the same cleaned body. It also checks that a difference outside the literal (`.trim()`) still gives different bodies.

The change is in the shared C-style extractor, so any language using it that has backticks in its code is also affected.

Nothing is committed.
